title: Oyo eyes January-March IPO as investors peg valuation at around $2 billion
summary: Oyo targets January-March IPO window at an estimated valuation of $2 billion
detailed: In an October filing, Oravel had cut its proposed IPO size by nearly half to Rs 3,350 crore, amid a recalibration of its fundraising plans. The hospitality firm's IPO is expected to be entirely a primary capital raise, with none of the shareholders selling stakes through an offer-for-sale (OFS) comp
